# Bundled helper

Source: https://github.com/waydabber/betterdisplaycli

Pinned commit: `117129a222b3e00e6ba00387830f2e9a0befb647`.

The unmodified Swift source is compiled for both architectures and bundled under
`OpenDDPM.app/Contents/Helpers/betterdisplaycli`. The upstream MIT license is
included both here and in the application resources. BetterDisplay itself is
not redistributed; it must be installed separately.
